mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day S&P 500 returns remains below 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window, or average 20-day returns in FEDFUNDS < 3.0% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market health, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In all instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for 3 consecutive months, 20-day forward returns are positive in >40% of cases, or Rank IC for the UNRATE threshold signal is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a synchronized demand-supply contraction, reducing corporate profit visibility and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * INDPRO) fails to predict negative 20-day returns in >50% of cases, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising), higher borrowing costs reduce corporate investment and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In all periods with FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising 0.5%+ in 3 months, 20-day forward returns are positive in >40% of cases, or Rank IC for the tightening signal is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 indicates weakening manufacturing output, reducing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 60-day S&P 500 returns is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window, or average 60-day returns in INDPRO < 95.0 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200.0 thousand units signals residential sector contraction, reducing consumer confidence and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In all months with HOUST < 1200.0, 5-day forward returns are positive in >40% of cases, or Rank IC for the HOUST threshold signal is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 400,000 million dollars indicates weak consumer spending, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In all months with RSAFS < 400,000 million dollars, 20-day forward returns are positive in >40% of cases, or Rank IC for the RSAFS threshold signal is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment (UNRATE) above 5.0% and declines in employment (PAYEMS) below 130,000 thousand persons indicate severe labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (UNRATE * PAYEMS) fails to predict negative 20-day returns in >50% of cases, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.
